condition: Right iliac fossa pain, CT planned
summary: 30-year-old woman with right iliac fossa pain; CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast planned; pregnancy status not recorded.

inputs.hpi: Two days of right iliac fossa pain, worse on walking. Nausea. Last period about five weeks ago.

exam.abdomen: Tender in the right iliac fossa, no peritonism.

investigations: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast

top.note: Female 12–55 before ionising imaging: pregnancy status first; the one-tap action adds a urine β-hCG as a suggested test.

guideline.name: RCR / SCoR / BIR — Protection of pregnant patients during diagnostic medical exposures to ionising radiation
guideline.section: Ask about pregnancy (12–55 years) before an examination that irradiates the abdomen or pelvis
guideline.citation: Royal College of Radiologists, Society and College of Radiographers, British Institute of Radiology. 2019.

rationale: Owner's example: a woman of 30 with a CT planned — pregnancy status first.
